outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with the door handle, then pulls the door outward and downward (frames 98–113, image and left_ego_image). The door is visibly open with the interior exposed by frame 113 and remains open through frame 147 after the gripper withdraws (image and left_ego_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or displacement of unrelated objects is established.
